report_summary.main_findings: Fracture of left clavicle confirmed by multiple X-ray images. Complete Blood Count (CBC) and Metabolic Panel results are available.
report_summary.patient_explanation: The patient has a fracture of the left clavicle, also known as the collarbone. This is confirmed by looking at several X-ray images of the shoulder. These X-rays show a break in the bone. Additionally, a blood test called a Complete Blood Count (CBC) and a Metabolic Panel was performed. The blood test results show normal levels for various blood components and chemical values. The patient's current status is stable. Recovery from a clavicle fracture typically involves rest, sometimes using a sling or brace, and physical therapy to regain strength and function, usually taking several weeks to months.
report_summary.recommendations: Follow-up imaging may be recommended by the physician depending on the fracture type and healing progress.
